description: GIS Evidence Registry for Mumbai Metro. Tracks all spatial data sources for each line — community repos, operator web GIS, OSM, survey data. Geometry must be validated before promotion to CTM.
coordinateSystem: WGS84 (EPSG:4326) — all CTM geometry must be in lon/lat decimal degrees
acquisitionPipeline: SOURCE → GIS Evidence Registry → Validation (DPR chainage / Wayfinder / cross-source) → Canonical Geometry → CTM

assetsAvailable.description: Station point features for Mumbai Metro Line 3
assetsAvailable.notes: Must validate station name and coordinate against DPR chainage/alignment

assetsAvailable.description: Detailed alignment/route geometry for Mumbai Metro Line 3 in CRS84
assetsAvailable.sizeNote: Large file — detailed coordinate sequence, potentially several hundred points
assetsAvailable.notes: Primary candidate for Line 3 CTM route geometry. Must validate curve radii and chainage against DPR Table 4.2.

assetsAvailable.description: Operator-facing station position data including entry/exit gates, lift positions, platform maps, nearby places
assetsAvailable.notes: Highest-authority spatial source for Line 3 station entrance/exit and accessibility data. Addresses B-gaps: entrance coordinates, lift positions, platform layouts. Requires structured extraction from Wayfinder web application.

assetsAvailable.description: OSM station nodes and route relations for operational Mumbai Metro lines 1, 2A, 2B, 7
assetsAvailable.notes: Bootstrap geometry for Lines 1/2A/2B/7 before official GIS is acquired. Confidence capped at 0.65. Must validate against operator station sequence before CTM ingestion.

stationPoints.promotionCriteria: Coordinate within acceptable tolerance of DPR chainage-derived position AND matches Wayfinder position where available

validationSources: SRC-NET-001 DPR Table 4.2 curve radii and chainages
alignmentGeometry.promotionCriteria: Curve radii consistent with DPR alignment table; no implausible straight segments through known curve sections

stationPoints.promotionCriteria: Station name matches operator list; sequence correct; coordinate within 200m of known location
stationPoints.ctmBlocker: Requires at least P0 station sequence evidence from operator source before coordinates can be promoted
